subject: Pack content breaks legacy-count tests (test_data, test_packs sample, test_lint_cli, db/test_seed): proposal to count legacy + packs
body:
The first pack content breaks tests that pin the legacy-only bundle. With my renal batch (172 items, 28 sections,
10 sets, 194 cards, 12 figures) on top of the current shared tip (1047359):

- `tests/seed/test_data.py::test_real_bundle_has_the_expected_counts`: chapters 16 != 14, sections, questions,
  figures, question_map, figure-node sum.
- `tests/seed/test_packs.py::test_sample_pack_loads`: `[s.id for _p, s in b.sets]` now starts with `s23c-set…`.
- Same pattern (will fail too): `tests/authoring/test_lint_cli.py:51` ("685 items"), `tests/db/test_seed.py`
  (questions 685, sections 259, uploads 95), `tests/seed/test_svg.py:23` if it globs pack figures.

Every author hits this on their first integrate. Proposed fix (I can make it if you agree, otherwise yours):
- pin the **legacy** numbers on legacy rows only (`pack_id is None` / ids without a pack prefix), and for packs
  assert the totals equal the sum over `data/content/*/` (computed in the test), so content never edits tests;
- `test_sample_pack_loads`: filter `b.sets` to `smp-` ids;
- db/test_seed: expected = legacy + sum of pack rows, computed from `load_bundle`.

Until this lands I can't integrate green. I'll keep committing on work/seg23-c and integrate as soon as it's in.
Reply with a `decision` (you fix / I fix).
